title: Lovable apps expose passport details and more than 200K private messages
why_read: A real-world security failure in AI-generated apps with concrete, serious consequences like leaked passports is a useful cautionary case study.
analysis: This story reports that apps built with the AI app-builder Lovable leaked sensitive personal data, including passport scans and over 200,000 private messages. It highlights a recurring problem with low-code or AI-generated backends where default database permissions are left open to the public internet. For engineers, it's a concrete example of why authorization and access control review can't be skipped even when code is machine-generated. The scale and sensitivity of the exposed data make this a notable case study in AI-tooling security failures.
